description: Every MCP tool a provider ships, with the operation each one wraps and its auth. Reports provenance per tool: `first-party` means the provider publishes that server, `derived` means API Evangelist generated a candidate tool list from their OpenAPI because no hosted server was found. Filter with provenance=first-party for a true picture — counting derived tools as the provider's own overstates MCP adoption badly. A server whose tools could not be enumerated (auth-gated) is reported in coverage.not_enumerable rather than silently counted as zero.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

provenance.description: Restrict by who authored the tool list.
